title: windowless_spawn's proof reads memory_sync's source rather than loading it
intention: windowless_spawn's proof holds memory_sync's spawn and its no-cairn skip by reading memory_sync.py's source, so no tooth of the tool's proof runs a device's code.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 at cairn bce45-rebased-on-main @ 3e62b55b5: cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_every_detached_spawn_takes_its_flags_from_the_helper.py:51-55 _load() runs cairn/devices/cc/scripts/memory_sync.py through importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, in teeth 2 (:88) and 4 (:143). A tool's proof is executing a device's code, which is the same reach bce45318b2e0's FIXME removed from the pulse tooth, and encapsulation_holds returns [] for cairn/tools/windowless_spawn because it reads only static imports. The orchestrator ruled the pulse tooth's fix, as a separate ticket so bce4 is not held.
traces_to: RULE 1 (a proof measures only its own component) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass).
how: Teeth 2 and 4 keep their names and bce45318b2e0's keys. Tooth 2 runs the tool's own unhelped_sites over a scratch copy of memory_sync.py, plus an AST check of push()'s one Popen. Tooth 4 reads by AST the guarded import and its loud, zero-returning ImportError handler. A new tooth reds any import of cairn.devices, or any _load/spec_from_file_location aimed at device code, in this proof. memory_sync.py does not change.

clauses.claim: memory_sync's push() has exactly one Popen, running git ... push -q, which spreads **detached_kwargs() and sets no flag key itself, and windowless_spawn's unhelped_sites finds no unhelped site in a copy of memory_sync.py
in push() the import of detached_kwargs sits in a try whose ImportError handler prints 'CC MEMORY SYNC' to sys.stderr and returns 0, and no Popen runs inside that try or its handler
no tooth of the windowless_spawn proof imports cairn.devices or hands device code to _load, spec_from_file_location, run_path or import_module

decisions.text: D1: the pulse tooth's pattern, applied to memory_sync: a source read, never a load. The teeth keep their names so bce45318b2e0's PROVES keys stand; this ticket adds its own three keys.

out: cairn/machines/build_inspector (encapsulation_holds is not extended here; f6ecce0822eb owns the general dynamic-import check)
